name: unity_get_status
title: Unity get status
description: Check whether the Unity Editor bridge is alive and report Editor, tunnel, selection and pending-change state.

name: unity_get_project_info
title: Unity get project info
description: Read the Unity project name, path, Editor version, platform and active scene.

name: unity_get_compilation_status
title: Unity get compilation status
description: Read current and most recent Unity script compilation status and messages.

name: unity_read_console
title: Unity read console
description: Read bounded entries from the current Unity Console. Internal Console reflection falls back to logs captured while the bridge is loaded.

maximumEntries.description: Maximum entries to return, from 1 to 200.

name: unity_read_editor_log
title: Unity read editor log
description: Read the tail of Unity's Editor log, bounded to the final 2 MB.

name: unity_search_scripts
title: Unity search scripts
description: Search C# source under Assets and, when enabled in Unity, Packages. Results are bounded.

name: unity_find_script_references
title: Unity find script references
description: Find bounded textual references to a class, method, field or other symbol in C# scripts, with optional case-sensitive matching.

name: unity_read_script
title: Unity read script
description: Read a bounded C# script using a project-relative Assets/ or permitted Packages/ path. The response includes a SHA-256 hash for safe change proposals.

path.description: Project-relative script path, for example Assets/Scripts/Player.cs.

endLine.description: Last line, one-based. Omit or use 0 for up to 400 lines.

name: unity_get_selected_script
title: Unity get selected script
description: Read the C# script currently selected in the Unity Project window.

name: unity_get_active_scene
title: Unity get active scene
description: Read active-scene metadata and a bounded hierarchy snapshot.

name: unity_inspect_selected_object
title: Unity inspect selected object
description: Inspect the selected GameObject, its components, prefab information and bounded serialized properties.

maximumPropertiesPerComponent.description: Maximum serialized properties per component, from 1 to 200.

name: unity_inspect_selected_hierarchy
title: Unity inspect selected hierarchy
description: Recursively inspect the selected GameObject and its children, including components, missing scripts and missing object references.

maximumObjects.description: Maximum GameObjects to return, from 1 to 1000.

maximumPropertiesPerComponent.description: Maximum serialized properties per component, from 1 to 200.

name: unity_inspect_selected_prefab
title: Unity inspect selected prefab
description: Recursively inspect the selected prefab asset or nearest selected prefab instance root, including child hierarchy, components, missing scripts, missing object references and bounded overrides.

maximumObjects.description: Maximum prefab GameObjects to return, from 1 to 1000.

maximumPropertiesPerComponent.description: Maximum serialized properties per component, from 1 to 200.

maximumOverrides.description: Maximum prefab property overrides to return, from 0 to 500.

name: unity_get_selected_asset_info
title: Unity get selected asset info
description: Inspect the selected Project asset, including path, type, GUID, labels and bounded direct or recursive dependencies.

recursiveDependencies.description: Include recursive dependencies instead of only direct dependencies.

name: unity_analyze_selected_folder
title: Unity analyze selected folder
description: Analyze the folder currently selected in the Unity Project window. Returns a bounded asset inventory plus script declarations, prefab missing-script/reference findings, Animator Controller summaries, compiler messages in the folder, and dependencies outside the folder.

analyzeScripts.description: Summarize C# scripts, namespaces, declarations, sizes and hashes.

analyzePrefabs.description: Inspect bounded prefab hierarchies for components, missing scripts and missing object references.

analyzeAnimatorControllers.description: Summarize Animator Controller parameters, layers, states, transitions, motions and clips.

includeExternalDependencies.description: Report direct dependencies that are outside the selected folder.

maximumAssets.description: Maximum assets to inventory and analyze, from 1 to 2000.

maximumDetailedItemsPerType.description: Maximum scripts, prefabs and Animator Controllers to analyze in detail per type, from 1 to 200.

maximumIssues.description: Maximum issue records to return, from 1 to 1000.

maximumDependencies.description: Maximum external dependencies to return, from 0 to 1000.

name: unity_inspect_animator_controller
title: Unity inspect animator controller
description: Inspect the selected Animator component, Animator Controller asset, or Animator Override Controller asset. Returns controller parameters, layers, nested state machines, states, Any State and Entry transitions, state transitions and conditions, blend trees, motions, animation clips, behaviours, and override mappings.

searchChildren.description: Search children when the selected GameObject has no Animator.

maximumStates.description: Maximum states across all layers, from 1 to 1000.

maximumTransitions.description: Maximum transitions across all state machines, from 1 to 2000.

maximumMotions.description: Maximum motion and blend-tree nodes, from 1 to 2000.

name: unity_get_animator_info
title: Unity get animator info
description: Compatibility alias for unity_inspect_animator_controller. Inspect the selected Animator Controller graph, including parameters, layers, states, transitions, conditions, blend trees, motions and animation clips.

searchChildren.description: Search children when the selected GameObject has no Animator.

maximumStates.description: Maximum states across all layers, from 1 to 1000.

maximumTransitions.description: Maximum transitions across all state machines, from 1 to 2000.

maximumMotions.description: Maximum motion and blend-tree nodes, from 1 to 2000.

name: unity_get_packages
title: Unity get packages
description: Read Packages/manifest.json and report its direct package dependencies.

name: unity_get_script_change_proposals
title: Unity get script change proposals
description: List pending or recent script replacement proposals. Proposals do not modify Assets until approved in Unity.

includeCompleted.description: Include applied, rejected, failed and superseded proposals.

name: unity_propose_script_text_patch
title: Unity propose script text patch
description: Submit one exact oldText-to-newText patch for an existing Assets/**/*.cs file. The old text must occur exactly once. This creates a pending proposal only; Unity does not modify the script until the user reviews and approves it in the bridge window. Provide the SHA-256 returned by unity_read_script to prevent stale edits.

oldText.description: Exact existing code block to replace. It must occur exactly once in the current script.

newText.description: Replacement code block. May be empty only when intentionally removing the matched block.

summary.description: Brief explanation of the intended change.

name: unity_propose_script_replacement
title: Unity propose script replacement
description: Submit a complete replacement for one existing Assets/**/*.cs file. This never edits the script immediately: it creates a pending proposal that must be reviewed and approved in the Unity bridge window. Provide the SHA-256 returned by unity_read_script to prevent stale edits.

newContent.description: Complete proposed C# file content, not a partial patch.

summary.description: Brief explanation of the intended change.

name: unity_inspect_runtime
title: Unity inspect runtime
description: Read bounded live Unity/ClientSim state, stable object IDs and nested serialized fields. Includes Rigidbody, Joint, Collider, Animator and optional VRChat pickup/owner/Udon variables. Does not inspect an external VRChat client.

name: unity_capture_view
title: Unity capture view
description: Return an MCP image of the Scene camera render or focused Game View. Scene capture excludes editor gizmos. Requires interactive Unity.

name: unity_propose_change_set
title: Unity propose change set
description: Create a pending set of 1-50 operations. User must enable change sets and approve inside Unity. Saved clean scenes, stable GlobalObjectIds and existing destination folders are required. Operations: set_property, add_component, create_gameobject, create_script, replace_script, save_prefab. New aliases use $name. Existing scripts require expectedSha256. No immediate project mutation.

name: unity_get_change_sets
title: Unity get change sets
description: List pending/recent change sets and rollback state. includeOperations includes full review content.

name: unity_propose_change_set_rollback
title: Unity propose change set rollback
description: Prepare a reviewed rollback of an applied change set. Blocks if assets changed after apply; approval remains in Unity.

name: unity_start_trace
title: Unity start trace
description: Record bounded Play Mode state changes and explicit [WDMCP_EVENT] logs without blocking a request. Sampled changes are not proof that an exact callback fired. One trace retained; read before a domain reload.

name: unity_read_trace
title: Unity read trace
description: Read trace events incrementally. firstAvailableSequence reveals dropped entries in the 2000-event ring buffer.

name: unity_stop_trace
title: Unity stop trace
description: Stop the named trace and return its first page of events.

name: unity_validate_vrchat
title: Unity validate vrchat
description: Inspect selected hierarchy for missing references, pickup/physics/Animator configuration and used-layer collisions. Includes compilation status. Does not replace SDK Network ID allocation or multiplayer/build testing.

name: unity_find_asset_references
title: Unity find asset references
description: Page through direct reverse asset dependencies in Assets, plus direct dependencies of the target asset. Save scenes before searching.

name: unity_check_runtime
title: Unity check runtime
description: Evaluate exact assertions against exposed current component runtime values. Requires Play Mode. Does not invoke gameplay callbacks or simulate other players.

name: unity_start_profiler
title: Unity start profiler
description: Start 1-30 seconds of nonblocking sampled Editor CPU/memory/render counters. Returns a session ID; not on-device FPS or per-script profiling.

name: unity_read_profiler
title: Unity read profiler
description: Read profiler session statistics and unavailable counters. Sessions reset on domain reload.

name: unity_stop_profiler
title: Unity stop profiler
description: Stop the named profiler capture, release recorders and return statistics.

name: unity_propose_editor_action
title: Unity propose editor action
description: Request a locally reviewed Editor action: enter/exit Play Mode, pause/resume/step, compile, or run Unity Test Framework tests. These actions can run project code; user approval is required in Unity.

name: unity_get_editor_actions
title: Unity get editor actions
description: List recent pending/completed Editor actions for local review.

name: unity_get_test_results
title: Unity get test results
description: Read the latest bridge-started Unity Test Framework run and bounded failure details. Results persist across domain reloads.
